title: Asymptotic stability of solutions to the good Boussinesq equation in dispersive wave region
summary: This work studies the asymptotic stability of solutions to the good Boussinesq equation in dispersive wave region when the reflection coefficients associated with the initial data belong to weighted Sobolev space. The Dbar-steepest descent method is applied to the Riemann-Hilbert problem and the long-time asymptotic expansion of the solution are obtained up to an optimal error of order $\mathcal{O}(t^{-3/4})$.
